description: This file declares the interface for a Rust implementation of KeyMint's main function, providing an extern 'C' linkage for use in C/C++ code. It defines a single function 'kmr_ta_main' which handles incoming and outgoing messages for secure environment tasks related to key management, with parameters specifying file descriptors, security level, a resource manager pointer, and a socket descriptor.

methods.name: kmr_ta_main
methods.description: Main function for the Rust implementation of KeyMint, handling secure environment messaging and communication based on provided file descriptors, security level, resource manager pointer, and socket descriptor.
